documented_probe: C-06ebb4a9 (change the default login shell of a user and persist it): the covering task exercises the capability at easy; the verifier re-runs the deliverable on hidden policy files and queries the live account database (getent passwd) to confirm the shell was actually set, fully checking the capability.
notes: Single-stage: apply a JSON shell policy to real local accounts via the account database (usermod/chsh) and report resulting shells. Generalization is probed by hidden policies that fully re-specify every account (rotate to /bin/dash, restore originals, mixed swaps) so the deliverable must read the policy rather than hard-code. Small rubric nonzero for tool_breadth (usermod/getent), hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness (exact shell strings), and interaction_statefulness (persistent /etc/passwd mutation). Totals bucket to easy.
